Name: Nice Day For Fishin' - Fishing QoL and tweaks
Author: VaryelStudios
Description:
[center][b][size=4]The name of this mod was inspired by [url=https://www.youtube.com/@VivaLaDirtLeague]VLDL[/url]﻿'s character; Baelin. Shoutout to them, they make really good videos.[/size]
[/b][/center]

[size=3][b]If you like the mod (and mods that made it possible) please endorse![/b][/size]

[size=3][b]For bug reporting/support use the "bugs" or "posts" section here on Nexus, or you can make a ticket on our [url=http://discord.gg/9VHSH4r7Sn]Discord[/url].

Currently supports:[/b]
Vanilla
Stardew Valley Expanded (no quests currently, will come in next update)[/size]

[size=3][b]Full list of toggleable features:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Increase/decrease difficulty of catching normal fish[/size]
[*][size=3]Increase/decrease difficulty of catching legendary fish[/size]
[*][size=3]Make fishing slightly easier at specific fishing levels[/size]
[*][size=3]Make fishing easier/harder depending on daily luck[/size]
[*][size=3]Remove garbage as a catchable item[/size]
[*][size=3]Remove specific time requirements for normal & legendary fish (separate toggles)[/size]
[*][size=3]Remove specific weather requirements for normal & legendary fish (separate toggles)[/size]
[*][size=3]Remove season requirements for all fish[/size]
[*][size=3]Increase/decrease the sell price of all fish[/size]
[*][size=3]Increase the sell price of all fish slightly at specific fishing levels[/size]
[*][size=3]Add quests for catching normal fish[/size]
[*][size=3]Add quests for catching legendary fish[/size]
[*][size=3]Adjust duration of fishing buff foods[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]Potential future updates, may change at any point:[/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Integrations with mods that add fish; SVE, Ridgeside Village, etc. Suggestions of those mods welcome![/size]
[/list][/size] ﻿ ﻿[size=3]- This includes all applicable features listed above, difficulty adjustments, quests, etc.
[list]
[*][size=3]Custom worm bins for different types of baits such as wild bait, in a manner that feels balanced.[/size]
[*][size=3]Custom NPCs and additional quests[/size]
[*][size=3]Any doable suggestions that don't feel gamebreaking or unbalanced.[/size]
[/list][/size]

Downloads.Description:
Made for 1.6+, may not work on older versions


Changelog:
Fixed Willy's summer quest not functioning properly

Manifest.Name: Nice Day For Fishin'
Manifest.Description: A mod aimed at tweaking the fishing experience to the player's preference. Includes options such as difficulty adjustments, dynamic difficulty adjustments based off the luck system, QoL options, and more!
